title: SpawnHere!
description: A mod that allows administrators to set a custom spawn point for new players when they first join the server.
body:
**SpawnHere!**

A mod for servers that allows administrators to manage the locations where new and existing players appear. It is intended for use in hub areas and survival multiplayer environments. It is a tool for those who want to maintain an organized arrival area without using complex software.

**Features**

By using this tool, you are able to establish a global arrival point from within the game.

As it includes a clear configuration file, you are able to adjust the settings to match specific requirements.

Due to its design for efficiency, it does not cause delays in server performance.

**Commands**

If you use the commands, you must have administrator permissions

_/ed setspawn_ - This command establishes the arrival point at your current position plus orientation.

_/ed reload_ - This command updates the configuration file so that modifications take effect immediately.

_/ed clearspawn_ - It deletes the recorded arrival point and returns the server to the original world location.
